description:
Perform a comprehensive HTTPS and protocol security audit of https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
2. Navigate to the 'Security' tab to analyze protocol security, mixed content, and insecure forms.
3. Export the Security tab data to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/security_tab_export.csv'.
4. Export the full Internal tab data to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/internal_all_export.csv'.
5. Create a security audit report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/security_audit_report.txt'.

The report MUST include:
- Total URL count and HTTPS vs HTTP breakdown.
- Assessment of mixed content issues.
- Assessment of HSTS headers.
- At least 3 specific remediation recommendations.
